description: This Java source file defines a generic base class 'ManagerFactoryBase' that provides functionality for creating proxy instances of API managers with public and optionally private interfaces. It manages singleton instance creation and access control via dynamic proxies.

classes.name: ManagerFactoryBase
classes.description: A generic base class for creating proxy-based manager instances with customizable interfaces and access controls.

methods.name: ManagerFactoryBase
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the factory with public, private interfaces, and invocation handler.

methods.name: getAPIInstance
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of the API, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: getProxyInstance
methods.description: Creates a proxy instance implementing public and optionally private interfaces, with access control enforced via the invocation handler.
